metadata.title: Why Amazon and Other AI Data Center Stocks are Post-Midterm Winners<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Amazon and Other AI Data-Center Stocks Will Be Post-Midterm Winners
The results of the 2026 midterm elections are already causing seismic changes in the world of artificial-intelligence spending. Despite the market turbulence for technology and energy stocks in the days immediately following the results, in the long run, hyperscaler stocks could benefit. But to do so, the companies driving the AI buildout are going to have to adapt to the new political reality.
